title: Hi, I'm $t(common:site.displayName)
description: Software engineering master's student, passionate about open source and technical sharing.
Aiming to become an engineer who solves real problems and delivers excellent experiences.
Not satisfied with merely finishing tasks, but turning experience into understanding through inquiry.

values.title: Value follows need
values.description: I believe creation should answer real problems. Technology and expression should serve actual needs, not showmanship or self-indulgence.

values.title: Refine relentlessly
values.description: I try to think through problems broadly, so function, edge cases, and details add up to a more reliable and comfortable experience.

values.title: Keep asking
values.description: Questions never end, but we can always ask one more and answer one more. Question by question, small inquiries accumulate into experience, judgment, and understanding.
